status_effects.explanation: The narrator moves from isolated grief in the empty dining room to being included in a friend's spontaneous invitation, though his own commentary keeps this positive shift muted.

appraisal_events.evidence: « Peut-on entrer ?... Je venais voir si tu ne voulais pas que nous allions dîner quelque part ensemble... »
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator is alone and sobbing when the unexpected visit interrupts his solitude and draws him into a shared evening, staging him as the recipient of an inclusion he himself treats ambivalently given his professed skepticism about friendship.
